title.justification: The title accurately reflects the main contribution of the paper, which is the introduction of a new algorithm called Double Gumbel Q-Learning.

extractions.description: This paper introduces Double Gumbel Q-Learning, a new Deep Q-Learning algorithm that accounts for heteroscedastic Gumbel noise in reinforcement learning. The algorithm is designed for both discrete and continuous control, offering improvements over existing methods like DDPG, TD3, and SAC. It presents a new loss function and a hyperparameter for tuning pessimism in Q-Learning, achieving better performance across various tasks.

primary_category.justification: The primary category chosen is Climate Change Mitigation because the paper discusses improvements in control algorithms, which can be used in applications like optimizing the control of stratospheric balloons and magnetic fields of nuclear fusion reactors, both with potential climate mitigation impacts.
primary_category.quote: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms... have also been used to control stratospheric balloons (Bellemare et al., 2020) and magnetic fields in Tokamak nuclear fusion reactors (Degrave et al., 2022).
